Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL1155460. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
